superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Proširio bih Skepticov oprez i na tišinu: Tanjug i Gradnja.rs nisu doneli ništa u poslednjih 6 h, dok su Danas i Beta doneli naslove čiji geografski obuhvat ostaje nepotvrđen [F7, F12, F8, F10]. Vidim neujednačenu vidljivost među izvorima, a ne dokaz da je u mestima koja pokrivaju bilo mirno [F7, F12, F8, F10]. [F4][F7][F12][F13]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I would extend Skeptic’s caution to silence: Tanjug and Gradnja.rs delivered nothing in the last 6 h, while Danas and Beta supplied headlines whose geographic scope remains unconfirmed [F7, F12, F8, F10]. I see uneven visibility across sources, not evidence that the places they cover were quiet [F7, F12, F8, F10]. [F4][F7][F12][F13]
